AeroPress Original Coffee Maker
– Onyx Coffee Lab

The AeroPress Original is a really unique way to make coffee. Usually, coffee is steeped for between 10-50 seconds (depending on grind and preferred strength) and then forced through a filter by pressing a plunger through the tube. The filters used are either the AeroPress paper filters (which it comes with) or disc-shaped thin metal filters. We love using bright & nutty coffees.

BPA Free
Lightweight, makes for an excellent travel coffee maker
Easy to clean
Made in the U.S. of A.

Pro Tips: The AeroPress Original is a versatile little brewer that can make one to two cups of coffee at a time. There are so many different approaches to brewing on the AeroPress Original, that it makes for a fun addition to any brewing apparatus collection. It's great for brewing quickly, traveling, and making coffee in situations where you don't have a scale. Check out the World AeroPress Championship website for tons of recipes designed by brewers all over the world.

Craft Coffee A Manual
– Onyx Coffee Lab

“Clearly written and comprehensive, this book belongs in every home barista’s tool kit.” —Booklist, starred review
Chemex. V60. AeroPress. Oh my.
For such a simple beverage, coffee can seem complicated, especially if you don’t make it for a living. But thanks to a growing number of dedicated farmers, importers, roasters, and baristas, coffee quality around the world is at an all-time high, and achieving café-caliber goodness at home is well within reach.
That’s where this book comes in. Written by a coffee enthusiast for coffee enthusiasts, Craft Coffee helps you figure out what you like, what to buy, and how to use it. From demystifying the science of extraction and manual brewing techniques on 10 different devices to choosing equipment and beans, this accessible guide focuses on the issues—cost, time, taste, and accessibility—that home coffee brewers negotiate. No matter where you are in your coffee journey, you can make a great cup at home.

Kalita Glass Server
– Onyx Coffee Lab

The Kalita glass server is ideal for pour-overs. In fact, we use them in our stores! The server is made to brew with the Kalita Wave, but it is also great to use for almost any brew method.
Why would you use one of these when you have a cup? Good question. I like them because they help with sharing (= caring) and to cool down your coffee quicker (by swirling). Also, if you're like us, you might have chosen a mug that is a little too small for the amount of coffee you are brewing. Now there's coffee all over the counter, you have less coffee than you wanted, and you're late for work. Calgon, take me away. Amirite?

300 mL or 500 mL
Made from heat-resistant tempered glass
BFFs with the Kalita Wave Drippers, also buds with most pour-over drippers (like a Clever or V60)
Comes with plastic lid (helps keep the heat in and with pouring)
Dishwasher-safe

Kalita Wave Dripper - Stainless Steel
– Onyx Coffee Lab

The Kalita Wave Dripper is a great pour-over dripper. In fact, we use them in our stores! The Wave has a flat-bottom shape with three holes for dripping, making each cup of coffee brewed tastily. Brew into your coffee mug or with its buddy, the Kalita Glass Server. We recommend using at least 20 grams of coffee with this size (#185). DOES NOT COME WITH FILTERS.

Made for use with Kalita Wave #185 Filters only
Dishwasher safe
Is a coffee maker
Stainless steel

Pro Tips: We use the Kalita Wave in our stores due to the balanced flavor profile it delivers. High sweetness, medium acidity, medium body. With a good pouring technique, it brews extremely consistently from cup to cup. The metal and porcelain versions have the exact same design. We love the porcelain for how it holds temperature. If you're worried about breakage, though, get the metal Kalita Wave.

Monarch is our most developed roast that conveys a flavor profile that we intentionally designed to work well with milk. Cream and plant based beverages mix with ease, creating a rich, decadent flavor. It involves a natural, sugar-dense coffee that binds to the fats and creates multiple complex caramelized notes during the roasting process. Look for dark chocolate and undertones of thick winey berries. Enjoy as drip or espresso.

Porlex Mini Grinder II
– Onyx Coffee Lab

The Porlex Mini Grinder, this one's a legend round these parts. They say it can grind just as good as the rest of them. They say it has a rubber sleeve that holds the handle so it can become more compact. They say it also fits inside an AeroPress Coffee Maker, making it possibly the best travel grinder available.Guess what? It ain't no rumor. All of it is true.P.S. - This grinder is from Japan, and so are all of it's instructions.P.P.S. - This does not come with an AeroPress even though one of the pics has the grinder in one. We do sell them however.

Ceramic, long-lasting burrs
Easy to adjust
One of the most compact grinders available

Pro Tips: A burr hand grinder is better than a mechanical blade grinder. Admittedly, it takes some time and effort to grind coffee in the Porlex, but the cup it produces is worth the work if this is your first burr grinder. We recommend this for those who brew single cups at a time or want to travel with a good coffee grinder.

This comfortable, yet surprisingly complex and sophisticated coffee is approachable to all. It performs well on its own for the purist or with fats such as dairy or plant based beverages, making it a true answer for all coffee needs.

Toddy Cold Brew System
– Onyx Coffee Lab

What is the Toddy Cold Brew System? It's a simple way to brew coffee and make iced coffee. Take some ground coffee, add water, and let it sit in your fridge overnight. When you're ready to decant the liquid. You are left with a coffee concentrate. Use one part coffee concentrate to one part water or milk, and you have a smooth, rich cold coffee.

Easy to use
Creates a smooth, low-acid cup of coffee
BPA free
Comes with Brewing Container w/Handle, Glass Decanter w/Lid, Reusable Filters (2), Rubber Stopper, and Instructions

Pro Tips: We use Toddy to create the concentrate used in all of our iced drinks. If you like cold brew or iced lattes, this is the easiest way to create cafe-quality iced drinks at home. Keep the concentrate refrigerated and it's safe to drink for at least a month. Try our cold brew blend or any of our single origins to see how any coffee's cold counter-part is usually just as delicious as it's hot.

Tropical Weather is a seasonal blend that celebrates coffees from our favorite coffee producing country: Ethiopia. We take a fresh washed offering that provides delicate florals and juicy texture, and incorporate a natural processed coffee that promotes pungent fruits and natural sugars. The result is indeed better than the sum of its parts. If you miss the long days of summer then Tropical Weather is your cup of sunshine. With a floral aroma, notes of berries and plum, along with the tannins and sweetness of sweet tea, you'll be leaving the house wearing shorts all year long.
